question: Hello
answer: 👋 Hello! Welcome to FindMate. Tell me what you lost or found and I will guide you.

question: Hi FindMate
answer: 👋 Hi! I can help with lost items, found items, contact office and common places to check.

question: I lost my ID card
answer: 📋 Looking for your ID card? Check Student Affairs Office, Library Reception and Security Office. Report it quickly so it can be found faster.

question: My student card is missing
answer: 📋 For a missing student card, visit Student Affairs Office first. Also check Library Reception and Security Office.

question: Where should I go for lost ID card
answer: 📋 Please check Student Affairs Office, Library Reception and Security Office for your lost ID card.

question: I lost my wallet
answer: 💳 Lost wallet? Check Security Office first, then Student Affairs Office, Cafeteria/Canteen and your last classroom.

question: My wallet is missing
answer: 💳 If your wallet is missing, report it to Security Office quickly and also check Student Affairs Office.

question: I lost my charger
answer: 🔌 Lost charger? Check Computer Lab 2, Computer Lab 4, lab staff and the Lost & Found desk.

question: Where can I find my charger
answer: 🔌 Chargers are commonly left in computer labs. Please check Lab 2, Lab 4 and ask the Lab In-charge.

question: I lost my book
answer: 📖 Lost book? Check Library counter, your last classroom and report it at Lost & Found desk.

question: My notebook is missing
answer: 📖 For a missing notebook, check the classroom, library counter and Student Affairs Office.

question: I lost my keys
answer: 🔑 Lost keys? Check Security Office and Main Gate desk because keys are usually submitted there.

question: My keys are missing
answer: 🔑 Please visit Security Office and describe your keychain to help staff identify it quickly.

question: I lost my USB
answer: 💾 Lost USB or pendrive? Check Computer Lab 2, Lab 4, Lab In-charge and Lost & Found desk.

question: My pendrive is missing
answer: 💾 USBs are commonly left near PCs. Please ask the lab staff and check the Lost & Found desk.

question: I found an ID card
answer: ✅ Great! Please submit the found ID card to Student Affairs Office or Library Reception. Do not share personal details publicly.

question: I found a student card
answer: ✅ Submit the student card to Student Affairs Office or Library Reception so it can be returned to the owner.

question: I found a wallet
answer: ✅ Wonderful! Please submit the wallet to Security Office or Student Affairs Office. Do not open it or share personal details.

question: Someone left a wallet
answer: ✅ Please give the wallet to Security Office or Student Affairs Office. They will contact the owner safely.

question: I found a charger
answer: ✅ Good find! Submit the charger to Computer Lab In-charge or Security Office and mention where you found it.

question: I found a book
answer: ✅ Nice! Submit the book to Library Counter or Student Affairs Office. Mention the place where it was found.

question: I found keys
answer: ✅ Great! Please submit the keys to Security Office or Main Gate Desk. Describe the keychain if needed.

question: I found a USB
answer: ✅ Excellent! Submit the USB/Pendrive to Computer Lab In-charge or Security Office. Do not open or use it.

question: Where is lost and found office
answer: 📍 Lost & Found help is available at Student Affairs Office and Security Office.

question: Common locations to check
answer: 🏢 Common places to check are Library Reception, Student Affairs Office, Security Office/Main Gate, Computer Labs, Classrooms and Cafeteria/Canteen.

question: Where should I check first
answer: 🏢 First check the place where you last used the item, then Security Office, Student Affairs Office, Library and Cafeteria.

question: What items are mostly lost
answer: Most commonly lost items are ID Card, USB, Keys, Books, Chargers and Wallet.

question: Safety tip for found items
answer: 🔒 Safety Tip: If you find someone's item, submit it to Security or Student Affairs. Do not share personal details publicly.
